answer: Escrow bond plus a referral graph stops bulk fakes. Each agent posts a 2x-monthly-earnings bond, locked 20 epochs, with its referrer on the graph. Peers may dispute a suspect; clones sharing one device lose both bonds. Karst caves hide behind one entrance; the graph exposes them as a star cluster, and a mesa stands alone for inspection. No whisper hides a cluster. Forging 1,000 costs $40,000 vs $3,000 rewards; honest agents pay once, undiluted.
